headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 15, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 18.72%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 11.30%. This results in an average alpha of 7.41%, indicating that the portfolios are not only rising in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 47.63%, contributing a dollar change of $476.29. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 11.71%, reflecting a more modest performance. The ability to outperform SPY during this period highlights the portfolio's resilience amid potential market volatility. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
